_comment: Canonical, repo-tracked source of the facts Hermes needs to parse a real Telegram procurement request correctly (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §4.1/§4.4, TODOS.md 'Give Hermes persistent project context'). This file is the source of truth; `node sync-to-hermes-profile.mjs` renders it (plus system-prompt.md) into the live, machine-local Hermes profile config that the Telegram gateway actually reads (see README.md for why that's a separate, out-of-repo file).
_devStandInSignerComment: Dev-only stand-in for real zkLogin (§4.5/§7 step 6, TODOS.md 'Bridge createOrder's unsigned tx to a signer'). Same address as AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY in agent/sui-mcp/.env -- one funded testnet account plays owner + agent during development, per §3 build checklist step 5. Replace every reference to this address with the real per-order zkLogin address once §7 step 6 lands.
_dashboardComment: Where /auth, /sign, and their APIs (owner-session lookup, pending-tx registration) live -- §4.5 steps 2-3, §7 step 6. localhost only until it's actually deployed.

watcher._comment: Local-only control endpoint the watcher process exposes (agent/watcher/src/httpServer.ts) so Hermes can trigger an immediate settlement check instead of waiting for the next poll tick (§4.3 point 2). Loopback-only, no auth -- it never does anything a scheduled tick wouldn't already do on its own.

_itemsComment: item -> vendor URL table. `priceCheckUrl` is what agent/watcher actually polls via checkVendorPrice (must be a signed JSON endpoint per IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §4.2's spec -- GET url -> {item, price_cents, unit, ts, supplier_address, sig}). `displayUrl` is a real, human-facing vendor page Hermes can share with the owner in conversation; it does not need to satisfy the signed-JSON spec. When `priceCheckUrl` isn't a real signed endpoint yet, the watcher will safely alert (never falsely settle) on any order created against that item -- see IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §9.1.

coffee.priceCheckUrlNote: agent/watcher/dev/vendor-stub.ts -- a local signed-quote stand-in, run alongside the watcher for demo/dev (see its own file header for how to start it).
coffee.displayUrlNote: Real mock-vendor site teammates built (§0.7/§7 step 2b). It's a display/catalog page today with no /api/price endpoint yet -- once teammates add the signed endpoint from the spec, swap priceCheckUrl to point at it and register their real pubkey via AdminCap (update_vendor_pubkey).

sugar.priceCheckUrlNote: Context-only real vendor page -- no signed price API exists for this item yet, so checkVendorPrice will fail loudly (never a false settlement) if an order is ever created against it. Swap for a real signed endpoint before relying on this item in a live demo.

rice.priceCheckUrlNote: Same caveat as sugar above -- context-only, not a signed endpoint.
